messages:
elaine_sales: Sierra (prospect) asked for a 10-day POC to validate SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (bulk + deltas), RBAC, and domain proofing. They want pricing and a short list of required artifacts by EOD. @tom_devx can we scope?

 tom_devx: Yep. Two POC paths: 1) Hosted quick-run (no dedicated infra) — 10 days, smoke SCIM + SAML + RBAC demo, limited SCIM QPS; 2) Dedicated short-reserve (mini pool) — full-rate SCIM, longer log retention, KMS integration if needed.

 nina_sec: Security checklist to ask them to provide: IdP metadata XML, desired NameID format, assertion signing/encryption preferences, cert rotation window, and whether they require HSM-backed keys for key material. Also ask for compliance regime (SOC2/ISO/GDPR) so we can surface contract addenda.

 arjun_eng: Engineering flags: if they expect >500k users we need bulk-import plan (S3 CSV import) + delta webhook. Delegated admin across tenants is an extra story. For RBAC, sample mapping of roles->permissions helps speed demo.

 elaine_sales: They said ~400k users initially, spikey provisioning during monthly syncs. Also asked about domain ownership proof and automated verification.

 tom_devx: Domain proof flow: DNS TXT for initial verification. For automated renewals we can support ACME-style or scheduled rechecks in Dedicated/Private. For the POC, DNS TXT is sufficient.

 arjun_eng: SCIM example we can share for their infra test: 
```
curl -X PATCH "https://scim.sierra.com/v2/Users/04f3b2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":false}]}'
```

 nina_sec: Also call out audit requirements: per-user audit trails available in Dedicated/Private. Hosted gives exportable logs but retention is limited; if they need tamper-evident logs we should discuss WORM or external SIEM ingest.

 infra-bot: Created POC ticket <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-20456> assigned to @arjun_eng for infra estimate.

 tom_devx: Ballpark pricing (very high level): Hosted POC (10 days) $4k-$8k — includes engineering hours and support. Dedicated mini-pool POC $12k-$22k — depends on reserved capacity and log retention. Add HSM/KMS legal addendum + engineering uplift if they insist on customer-managed HSM.

 elaine_sales: Great — can you turn that into a one-pager? I'll attach to the SOW and ask them for the checklist items. Also note: they asked about SCIM rate limits during monthly syncs — include test plan for load-run.

 arjun_eng: Will put together test plan: bulk import, delta window tests, and RBAC mapping verification. If they want delegated admin across tenants we'll need an extra 3-4 dev days.

 nina_sec: I'll draft the security Q and the HSM/legal notes and post here. If they want HSM for the POC we should warn of timeline impact.

 elaine_sales: Thanks team — I'll chase the artifacts and update here when we hear back. :slightly_smiling_face:
